---
title: "Optional abilities"
description: "Keep talent-dependent abilities from breaking routine registration."
---

Create and validate required core spells first. Register the routine only when all core spell objects are available. Optional spells can enhance the package afterwards.

```lua
local required = { "Builder", "Spender" }
for _, name in ipairs(required) do
  if not spells[name] then
    error("warrior/arms/basic/rotation.lua: missing required spell " .. name)
  end
end

if spells.OptionalCooldown then
  spells.OptionalCooldown:callback(function(spell)
    return spell:castable() and spell:cast()
  end)
end
```

Only render an option for an optional ability when that spell is present.
